scene_1.title: NEO-CHICAGO :: OVERWATCH TERMINAL
scene_1.dialogue:
Senior Dev Vex drops onto your desk a printout of an incoming API request from an unknown decker. 'The player login server is throwing erratic 500 errors. Look at this raw payload:

Payload: admin' OR '1'='1'; DROP TABLE users; --

What kind of threat vector are we looking at here?'

choices.text: It's a SQL Injection (SQLi) attempt attempting authentication bypass and data deletion.
It's a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payload trying to hijack session cookies.

scene_2_success.title: DATABASE DEFENDED
scene_2_success.dialogue: Vex nods approvingly. 'Good catch. We blocked the query at the gateway using parameterized inputs. But now the decker is attempting a credential stuffing attack against the player portal...'

scene_2_fail.title: CRITICAL SYSTEM BREACH
scene_2_fail.dialogue: You misidentified the threat! The un-sanitized SQL query executes on the database server. Player accounts are wiped, and the game backend goes offline.
